# Pahina Builder Suite

> AI-Powered Website & Sales Funnel Generator by Digitera Levi (Levi Mariano, Philippines). Users fill in business details and Pahina Builder Suite writes and designs a complete sales page, website or sales funnel, without manual coding.

## Who it is for
- Virtual assistants and freelancers who want to offer website and sales funnel services to clients.
- Small business owners who want their own sales page or website.

## What it does
- Builds sales funnels, business websites, sales pages, portfolios, product catalogs, lead magnet funnels, booking funnels and course pages.
- Unlimited pages and funnels, including pages for clients.
- Funnel pages: opt-in, sales, upsell, downsell, thank-you, about, services, contact and booking.
- Checkout and payment options, booking, FAQ chatbot, opt-in with free gift, coupons and order bump.
- Built-in SEO for every page: title and description, social sharing tags, structured data, sitemap, robots.txt and llms.txt in the export.
- Editing tools: edit text and images, move and reorder sections, AI assistant, versions and undo.

## Pricing
- One-time payment of PHP 3,495. No monthly software subscription.
- Uses the buyer's own free Google Gemini API key; Gemini free-tier daily usage limits apply.
- Access is delivered automatically by email after payment (app link, guide link and license key).
- Refund policy is fix-first: report a problem within 3 days, it is fixed within 48 hours, and a refund is given only if it cannot be fixed.
- Buyers may build unlimited pages for clients. Reselling the app itself requires the separate White Label license.
